# Health & Hygiene Report 0.1.7

## Findings

- The Finding action is now **Delete** instead of Dismiss.
- Deleting a Finding also removes its associated corrective action from the inspection.
- Findings dismissed by earlier versions are no longer included in active reports.

## Excel and Word

- Improved evidence-photo sizing when one side has one photo and the other has two.
- Mixed 1-vs-2 and 2-vs-1 layouts now use equal individual photo tile sizes.
- A single photo remains centered and uncropped.
- Two-photo layouts retain the accepted True Cover presentation.

## Dates

- Inspection dates now use an English display format such as **15 Aug 2026**.
